semantic.justification: Composes the browser Writer session from document, shell, frame, persistence, and presentation adapters without claiming the upstream swmodule implementation path. Iteration105 restores the existing paragraph StyleApply slot5552 to the stable SwDocShell owner with active SwView/GetWrtShell lifecycle, retaining the text-shell paragraph primitive. Caller-owned typed Template5552/Family5553 and Style6703/FamilyName5566 arguments and ordinary UNO/URL payloads preserve paragraph family2 defaults and recognized family-name precedence, paired programmatic-to-display conversion, actual custom or renamed style ownership, missing-name rejection, no-op family success and unsigned owner completion. Dispatcher preserves completed owner return items. Independent real model/view/frame/session tests cover current-style ID state, point/mark, history, graph replacement and instance isolation. Other style families, StyleDesigner, API-mode returns, modifier/reset/list/full-selection handling, the complete native style pool and native state itemset remain unverified; no status/default/exception promotion or registered save/open/recovery changes.
